Job description

Hiring for Python Developer




Responsibilities

A day in the life of an Infoscion

As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to actively aid the consulting team in different phases of the project including problem definition, effort estimation, diagnosis, solution generation and design and deployment

You will explore the alternatives to the recommended solutions based on research that includes literature surveys, information available in public domains, vendor evaluation information, etc. and build POCs

You will create requirement specifications from the business needs, define the to-be-processes and detailed functional designs based on requirements.

You will support configuring solution requirements on the products; understand if any issues, diagnose the root-cause of such issues, seek clarifications, and then identify and shortlist solution alternatives

You will also contribute to unit-level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high quality value adding solutions to customers. If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!




Educational Requirements

MCA, MSc, MTech, B.Tech, BCA, BSc

Job description

Data Engineer
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer with 2–3+ years of experience and strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure, SQL, Python, Snowflake, and modern data engineering practices. The ideal candidate should have experience building and optimizing scalable data pipelines, working with cloud-based data platforms, and supporting data integration, transformation, and analytics initiatives.


Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT data pipelines for processing large volumes of data.
Develop data integration and transformation workflows using Azure data services.
Build and optimize data models, data warehouses, and data lake solutions.
Write efficient and scalable SQL queries and Python scripts for data transformation and automation.
Work with Snowflake for data warehousing, data loading, query optimization, and performance tuning, where applicable.
Develop and maintain workflow orchestration and data pipeline processes.
Implement CI/CD practices and deployment automation using Azure DevOps.
Collaborate with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Product Managers, and other business stakeholders.
Ensure data quality, security, governance, and reliability across data platforms.
Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline, data quality, and performance-related issues.
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


Required Skills & Qualifications
2–3+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure Data Engineering services.
Strong proficiency in SQL and Python.
Good understanding of ETL/ELT, data pipelines, data warehousing, and data lake concepts.
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation.
Experience working with cloud-based data solutions and modern data engineering practices.
Hands-on experience with Snowflake is highly preferred.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Good communication and collaboration skills.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.


Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Apache Airflow or other workflow orchestration tools is a plus.
Experience with large-scale data migration and modernization projects is a plus.
Knowledge of data governance and security best practices.
Relevant Azure, Snowflake, or cloud certifications are a plus.
